entities.summary: Megan Elizabeth Gustafson is a professional basketball player for the Las Vegas Aces of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). Born in the United States, she represents Spain at the international level and made her Olympic debut in 2024 playing for Spain at the 2024 Summer Olympics.
